title: Fractured buccal cusp on a premolar, temporary bonding

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: I bit down on a popcorn kernel last night and something broke.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Yes, number twelve has lost the buccal cusp. No pain to cold, nerve looks healthy.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: I'll smooth it and do a temporary bonding on twelve today so it doesn't cut your cheek.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Long term number twelve needs a crown. Let's book that for next month.
